svg.title: The same constant module, two categories for Ext
svg.desc: On the left, the poset Q has minima 1 and 2, maxima 3 and 4, and an arrow from each minimum to each maximum. Every stalk of its constant module C is k and all four arrow maps are identities. The crossing of the diagonal arrows is not a vertex. On the right, a one-point poset has the vector space k. The map q sends all four labels to the point; pullback recovers C. Over Q, applying Hom to the displayed projective resolution gives the matrix with rows (1, minus 1) and (1, minus 1), of rank one, so Ext in degree one is k. Over a point every short exact sequence of vector spaces splits, so Ext in degree one is zero.

g.text: Ext depends on the chosen category
Pulling k back along q recovers C.
The resolutions belong to different categories
Over Q: k² → k² has rank one
Over the point, vector space sequences split:
